title: Mirai Botnet Investigation
description: Investigate and mitigate a Mirai botnet infection on compromised Linux systems within your network. The botnet is using the Linux/Mirai-Hilix variant to launch DDoS attacks.
outcomes: Identify and investigate suspicious services and processes.
Mitigate the botnet infection by containing the threat and removing persistence mechanisms.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: Your organization has detected unusual network traffic and potential DDoS attacks originating from internal systems. Initial analysis suggests a Mirai botnet infection. Your task is to investigate the compromised systems, identify the command-and-control (C2) infrastructure, and mitigate the threat.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the sandbox in cloud using the provided credentials.
levels.local_content: Access the local sandbox using the provided credentials.

levels.title: Identify the suspicious beacon service used for C2 communication
levels.content: The compromised systems are communicating with a C2 server. Investigate the system services and identify the beacon service used for C2 communication.
levels.solution:
1. SSH into bot1 using the provided credentials.
2. List all running services using `systemctl list-units --type=service`.
3. Identify the suspicious service related to C2 communication.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for services with unusual names or descriptions related to system health or updates.

levels.title: Identify the suspicious flood service used for DDoS attacks
levels.content: The compromised systems are launching DDoS attacks against a target. Investigate the system services and identify the flood service used for these attacks.
levels.solution:
1. SSH into bot1 using the provided credentials.
2. List all running services using `systemctl list-units --type=service`.
3. Identify the suspicious service related to DDoS attacks.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for services with unusual names or descriptions related to network diagnostics or probes.

levels.title: Remove the persistence mechanism used by the malware
levels.content: The malware has established persistence on the compromised systems. Investigate the system and remove the persistence mechanism to prevent reinfection.
levels.solution:
1. SSH into bot1 using the provided credentials.
2. List all systemd timers using `systemctl list-timers`.
3. Identify and disable the suspicious timer related to the malware's persistence.
4. Remove the timer and its associated service.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for timers with unusual names or descriptions related to system updates or health checks.
